name: Purchase Orders
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
    *   Target Audience: An enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements and new features).
    *   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
    *   Cluster Description: Addition of generic setup services and response alignments supporting purchase order details on listings.
    *   Raw Items:
        1.  `#714`: Refactor `get#PurchaseOrders` to return PO headers (instead of items) with the nearest delivery date.
        2.  `#696`: New `setup#PurchaseOrder` service. Centralizes creation/update. Supports external imports, product/facility/supplier resolution and validation, and status management.

    *   *Structure for New Features/Enhancements:* Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   *Structure for Bug Fixes:* "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   *Style:* Simple, active voice, granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features).
    *   *Tone:* Professional, utility-focused.
    *   *No-Go Words (AI Slop):* enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust.
    *   *No Exclamation Points:* Use periods only.
    *   *No "dev-time bugs":* Don't mention fixes/issues found during development of new features
